# Maxnova & Luci Global

> MAXNOVA & LUCI GLOBAL LLC is a Florida limited liability company, formed in April 2026, that builds and operates its own software products, DypOS, MOY IQ and Esmalia, and offers AI software development and US market entry support to Latin American companies.

Facts: Florida document number L26000222229, filed 2026-04-20, effective 2026-04-21. Founder: Walter La Madriz. Contact: maxnovaluciglobal@gmail.com.

- [Products overview](https://maxnovaluci.com/products/): prices, demos and current limits.

- [Esmalia](https://esmalia.com/): software for dental clinics.

## Services
- [Services](https://maxnovaluci.com/services/): AI software and SaaS development; US market entry support. Quoted per project. Not legal or tax advice.
